# dadaia-workspace

> A local-first, spec-driven workspace that gives AI agents current context, a document-governed lifecycle, visible concurrency and anti-slop boundaries.

## What it is

<!-- derived-from: product-vision sha256:47aa88f339e9 -->

- [README](README.md): the unit is the context (a Spec Context Project); documents are the lifecycle; boundaries are mechanical; concurrency is visible, never locked.

## Install

<!-- derived-from: pypi-distribution sha256:80d67bd879ea -->
<!-- derived-from: workspace-init sha256:5b20a0d9dc80 -->

- [PyPI project](https://pypi.org/project/dadaia-workspace/): `pip install dadaia-workspace`, then `dadaia init`.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): one section per published version.

## The law

<!-- derived-from: agentic-entities sha256:17de3503dfb4 -->
<!-- derived-from: sdd-gate-v3 sha256:a3fcecc38fa6 -->

- [DADAIA.md](dadaia_workspace/public/data/DADAIA.md): the always-on law, projected to the workspace root and to each harness runtime root.
- [Constitution](specs/constitution.md): the derivation law for personas, behaviors, rules and skills.
